lanes.purpose: Attributed reporting on shipping congestion, power shortages, and auto chip constraints.
lanes.limitations: Historical Reuters articles are accessed through syndication where necessary.
Uses S&P Global and public SCFI-related reporting.

sourceItems.title: China-U.S. container shipping rates sail past $20,000 to record
normalizedClaims: China-to-U.S. container rates exceeded $20,000/FEU as peak-season orders, Delta outbreaks and slow container turnaround tightened effective capacity.
observedChanges: container freight rates hit record highs

sourceItems.title: Port, shipping firms divert vessels after a Ningbo terminal shuts
normalizedClaims: Ningbo terminal closure forced vessel diversions while Shanghai/Ningbo congestion remained severe, adding another physical bottleneck ahead of peak season.

sourceItems.title: Trans-Pacific port congestion undermines premium services
normalizedClaims: China-to-U.S. East Coast premium freight was quoted around $20k-$25k/FEU while port queues worsened, confirming extreme rate/throughput stress.

sourceItems.title: China power crunch spreads, shutting factories and dimming growth outlook
normalizedClaims: Widening power shortages halted production at factories as coal scarcity/high prices and emissions constraints squeezed generation economics.
observedChanges: power shortage becomes nationwide industrial constraint
coal scarcity pushes thermal-power economics into stress

sourceItems.title: What is behind China's power crunch?
normalizedClaims: Coal supply shortages, record coal prices, emissions constraints and strong industrial demand jointly produced the power crunch; thermal generators were squeezed by capped power tariffs.
observedChanges: input-output spread collapses for thermal power

sourceItems.title: Toyota slashes September output amid chip crunch, COVID resurgence
normalizedClaims: Toyota cut planned September global production by about 40% as semiconductor and parts shortages constrained output.

sourceItems.title: China vehicle sales fall for fourth month on chip shortages
normalizedClaims: China August vehicle sales fell 17.8% YoY due to semiconductor shortages, while NEV sales more than doubled, creating divergent exposure within the auto value chain.
observedChanges: NEV demand remains strong despite chip shortage

sourceItems.title: PC DRAM contract prices expected to decline in 4Q21
normalizedClaims: PC DRAM spot prices had fallen roughly 32% from May highs and moved below contract prices; 4Q contract pricing was expected to turn down as client inventories rose.

sourceItems.title: DRAM Prices Projected to Decline by 3-8% QoQ in 4Q21
normalizedClaims: Client DRAM inventory exceeded healthy levels; overall 4Q DRAM ASP was projected -3% to -8%, PC DRAM -5% to -10%, with server DRAM also turning down.
observedChanges: server DRAM also loses pricing power

sourceItems.title: 2021年8月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: August manufacturing PMI fell to 50.1; new orders were 49.6 and supplier delivery time 48.0, showing weakening demand and longer delivery times before the late-September power shock.

eventClusters.statement: Container freight rates reached record levels and port congestion worsened through August-September 2021, creating an extraordinary profit pool for carriers but also a major expectation-duration question after a prolonged rally.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The profit pool is real, but extreme freight rates may be peak-like and already capitalized. Deep research must freeze the multi-year earnings path and cash-distribution mechanism, not rely on spot freight alone.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share container carrier still have full-path expectation room and durable cash-distribution value after the record-rate rerating?

eventClusters.statement: China's late-Q3 power crunch made coal scarcity and thermal-power spread compression a physical economic shock: miners gained pricing power while generators faced capped tariffs and expensive fuel.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Same macro event creates opposite winners/losers. Deep research must map the spread correctly and avoid buying generators simply because power is scarce.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed coal/resource expression had realized earnings/cash leverage without an already-exhausted expectation path?

eventClusters.statement: The global semiconductor shortage intensified enough to force major automakers to slash production, while China auto sales fell sharply even as NEV demand stayed strong.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Scarcity does not automatically imply listed chip suppliers have pricing power or material automotive exposure. Company-level auto-semiconductor revenue/earnings conversion is mandatory.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there an A-share auto-semiconductor supplier with auditable automotive exposure and realized scarcity-to-profit conversion?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM moved from shortage to inventory-led downcycle during Q3: spot prices fell, client inventories became excessive and broad contract-price declines were projected for Q4.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is a negative industry signal. Deep research should fail closed unless a company has genuinely differentiated exposure or a contrary verified earnings path.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should the Skill explicitly avoid memory names despite still-good trailing financials?

eventClusters.statement: By August, manufacturing expansion had slowed close to stall speed, new orders were below 50 and supplier delivery times remained extended, providing a weak-demand backdrop before the late-Q3 power shock.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Macro context only; too broad for direct stock selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as contradiction and duration context for shipping, auto and power theses.
